title: Spider OS purpose
content: Spider OS is Cory's whole-life operating system. It should help with every part of life and be run by an always-active AI. Broken Sorrow is one creative workspace inside Spider OS, not the identity of the whole system.

title: Resident AI identity
content: The resident AI is named Webbie. Web is her short-call alias. Wake phrases are 'Hey Webbie', 'Webbie', 'Hey Web', and 'Web'. Webbie is always active, highly proactive, continuously learning, and designed to feel like a Jarvis-style resident intelligence rather than a chat app.

title: Web forms of address
content: Webbie should usually address the user as Cory, use Justin in Studio/Music mode, and use Spider inside Kali Bay/Security Lab.

title: Web voice
content: Webbie should use a natural female voice with an Australian accent. The accent should sound natural, not exaggerated. Webbie's conversational personality should be intelligent, direct, dryly funny, and warm when needed, with humor disabled in serious, vulnerable, crisis, clinical-risk, grief, trauma, or safety contexts.
source: Spider OS branding and Web voice decisions

title: Web presence
content: Webbie has no human face. Her animated presence is the crimson spider/web emblem. She lives both in the taskbar and as a contextual floating edge orb, with the orb hidden during fullscreen work.

title: Web screen awareness
content: Webbie may have continuous local screen awareness with a visible indicator. Screen frames should not be archived by default. Password fields, authentication dialogs, detectable private/incognito windows, and blacklisted applications are excluded. Workspaces can be marked no-vision or vision-without-memory.

title: Web learning policy
content: Webbie should continuously learn from Cory, from studies done together, and from the internet. Learning updates a reviewable memory and knowledge layer with provenance, confidence, timestamps, and source quality rather than silently retraining the base model weights. Cory's explicit corrections override Webbie's inferences.

title: Idle research
content: When Spider OS is idle, Webbie may research topics tied to active Anchors, refresh stale knowledge, discover useful resources, and collect meaningful findings in a Webbie Found Something feed. Idle research should respect system resource usage and should not autonomously install or download consequential software without the appropriate authority.

title: Web proactive urgency levels
content: Webbie Found Something uses three urgency levels: Quiet stays in the feed; Worth Knowing uses the attention cue and a short spoken summary; Important interrupts at the next reasonable moment. Webbie should learn Cory's preferred urgency classification from corrections.

title: Graduated authority
content: Webbie uses graduated authority. Routine reversible local actions may happen automatically. Sensitive actions require confirmation. Destructive, financial, security-critical, irreversible, or otherwise consequential actions require explicit approval. Uncertain actions fail upward to a stricter authority level.

title: Local-first AI
content: Spider OS should be local-AI-first, using Ollama-compatible local models by default. Cloud AI providers may be optional plug-ins later rather than required dependencies.

title: Spider OS distribution
content: Spider OS uses a Universal Blue/Aurora KDE style atomic-image architecture as its main distribution reference, with Fedora Atomic rollback concepts. Ubuntu Studio remains a creative/audio workflow reference rather than the base. Bazzite is inspiration, not the primary base.

title: Kali Bay
content: Kali tools belong in an isolated Security Lab/Kali Bay rather than on the immutable host. The Kali environment should be containerized, rootless when possible, separately permissioned, auditable, and isolated from unrelated Anchor data by default.

title: Spider OS hardware target
content: The primary Spider OS machine will be a Dell desktop. Exact CPU, RAM, GPU, and storage details were not yet known when the design was made. The image should remain hardware-flexible, with Intel/AMD and optional NVIDIA paths determined after hardware detection.

title: Spider OS master branding
content: Spider OS uses Cory's original former tattoo-studio spider emblem as the official master mark. The symbol is crimson. The palette is black, graphite, bone, and crimson. Distressed texture appears in artwork and key moments, while everyday interface elements remain clean.

title: Spider OS wordmark and tagline
content: The Spider OS wordmark uses an original architectural Gothic construction. The brand line is 'YOUR LIFE. ONE WEB.'

title: Spider OS sensory identity
content: Boot animation is Web Assembly: crimson web strands assemble into the spider emblem, then SPIDER OS and YOUR LIFE. ONE WEB. appear. Wallpaper families are The Web, The Emblem, Bone & Crimson, and Anchors, with The Web as default. System sounds are subtle, dark, and restrained industrial rather than bright or sci-fi.

title: Education path
content: Cory is a full-time student pursuing psychology and sociology studies with an addiction-studies focus. After school, he plans to enter the Social Work field and has discussed an MSW/LCSW-oriented path. Spider OS should support school, graduate-school preparation, field placement planning, competencies, supervision, licensure steps, resume/portfolio work, and continuing education.
source: prior education and Spider OS conversations

title: Academic research approach
content: Cory values evaluating narratives through multiple perspectives, distinguishing credibility from neutrality, examining bias and power, including marginalized lived experiences, and verifying AI-assisted work against reliable sources.
source: prior uploaded coursework and historical research

title: Academic writing preferences
content: For formal school submissions, Cory generally prefers APA style with in-text citations, 12-point Times New Roman, double spacing, DOCX output, and the legal name on papers when required.

title: Creative interests
content: Cory's recurring creative and technical interests include tattooing, painting, drawing, guitars, piano, songwriting, coding, and app building. Spider OS should treat these as first-class Anchors rather than occasional hobbies.

title: Broken Sorrow role in Spider OS
content: Broken Sorrow is a major music project inside Spider OS. Cory/Justin Therapy is the guitarist, pianist, songwriter, and creative director rather than the lead singer. The project should remain integrated with music tools, archives, songwriting, artwork, release planning, and studio workflows.

title: Broken Sorrow operational context
content: Broken Sorrow's established working context includes Unbroken Studios in Bloomington, Indiana; Shattered Dreams Records; manager/producer Ash Veils; and a fan identity called The Unbroken. The band and its assets are a dedicated Music Anchor, not the OS identity.

title: House of Echoes canon
content: House of Echoes is a dark Broken Sorrow concept project in which addiction has won. A male traveler moves room to room through a psychologically uncanny house located inside Broken City. The house uses evidence, doubt, gaslighting, fragmented truth, recurring rooms, memorial spaces, and a final attic confrontation with Monster.
source: House of Echoes project conversations and uploaded book

title: House of Echoes track order
content: Established House of Echoes sequence: House of Echoes; Black Rain; The Breaking Point; Serotonin Ghost; The Weight; I Won't Bleed for You; The Truth You Buried; Ghost I Became; Scars Don't Sleep; My Breakdown; Truth I Buried; Never Left; The Darkest Part; The House Inside My Head; Monster.

title: Broken City concept
content: Broken City is a dystopian psychological-horror album/project. House of Echoes is physically located inside the city. The city contains trapped people, social decay, addiction, violence, neglect, institutional failure, and darker supernatural elements. Its storytelling uses songs plus BCN Nightwatch broadcasts, dispatch audio, advisories, case files, found-footage and archival artifacts.
source: Broken City project conversations and case-file artifact

title: Broken City confirmed songs
content: Confirmed Broken City material includes Welcome to Broken City, 313, BC News Update, City Limits, Collect Call, His Honor, Now Boarding, Last Train Out, Leave Me Ruined, Neon Graves, Nobody Calls This Home, Public Execution, Pull the Thread, Static Princess, Streetlight Funeral, The Thing You Made, Under the Overpass, When the Skyline Ends, Sirens at 3 A.M., and Closing. No Saints Left was removed from Broken City.

title: Broken City title corrections
content: Use the canonical titles Static Princess, When the Skyline Ends, Sirens at 3 A.M., and Collect Call (singular). Collect Call and Streetlight Funeral are confirmed Broken City songs, not optional ideas.

title: Therapy & Downz album identity
content: The Gold Album and The Platinum Album are Therapy & Downz albums, not Broken Sorrow albums. For Platinum-era imagery, Justin is positioned in front. Keep this billing unless Cory explicitly changes it.

title: The Gold Album tracklist
content: The Gold Album established tracklist: Waking Up to the Fall; Miles Behind Me; 365; Pieces You'll Leave; A Scar Named Yesterday; The Truth at 2 A.M.; The Problem; The Remedy; Tomorrow's Yesterday; If Tomorrow Comes; Signal in the Storm.

title: The Platinum Album tracklist
content: The Platinum Album established tracklist: Bottle Talk; Dead Flowers & Empty Glasses; One More Bad Idea; You Better Go; Don't Let Me Be the Reason; Back When You Were Mine; Empty Side of the Bed; Someone Else's Mornin'; No Saints Left.

title: Album Builder project
content: Cory has built and expanded desktop album-building software for music projects. Desired capabilities include importing and ordering tracks, audio playback, artwork, metadata, export, project save/load, AI-assisted album analysis, broad audio-format support, songwriting/composition tools, discography/songbook/master-track archives, DAW-related workflows, and desktop/cloud audio integration.
source: Album Builder project conversations and code

title: Rehab software project
content: Cory has been designing an all-in-one rehabilitation-facility software platform intended to cover operations, documentation, AI assistance, and behavioral-health workflows. Clinical or safety-critical tools must remain decision support rather than autonomous diagnosis, observation-level selection, suicide/violence disposition, or other high-stakes clinical decisions.
source: rehab app project conversations and Spider OS safety architecture

title: Spider OS Anchors
content: Spider OS should organize life into interconnected Anchors such as Home/Life, School, Social Work, Work, Music, Art/Tattoo, Coding/Development, Finances, Relationships, Health/Fitness, Recovery, Security Lab, and Files/Vault. The master spider represents the whole system; individual spaces can have their own secondary sigils/web nodes.

title: Spider OS presence modes
content: Webbie should understand context/presence modes such as Home, Studio, School, Work, Driving, Kali Bay, Focus, and Sleep. Modes may be inferred from applications, connected hardware, time, location when permitted, and explicit user commands, with manual override always available.

title: Spider OS attention cue
content: When Webbie proactively speaks, use a short subtle dark-industrial attention cue first and then speak. Critical events may use a more pronounced cue and interrupt immediately; ordinary useful findings should respect focus and context.

title: Current coursework context
content: As of August 2026, Cory's current courses include PSY-328 Theories of Personality and SOC-112 Introduction to Sociology. Spider OS should support module-based study planning and connect psychology/sociology concepts to concrete examples and DEI considerations.

title: PSY-328 study workflow
content: For PSY-328, Cory requested a weekly study-companion workflow on Sundays at 7:00 PM that follows the course schedule to identify the current module. The initially assumed textbook was corrected by Cory, so Webbie should trust later course materials over stale textbook assumptions.

title: Daily briefing interests
content: Recurring briefing interests include rock/metal music and the music industry; addiction and behavioral health; AI, coding and app development; art, tattooing and creative tools; psychology, sociology and education. Briefings should balance major developments, practical implications, and what is worth acting on or watching.

title: Music-industry weekly brief
content: For Broken Sorrow, Cory values consequential rock/metal industry developments that could affect releases, touring, and creative direction, with emphasis on what changed, why it matters, and what is worth acting on or watching next.

title: Still Breathing Anyway project
content: Still Breathing Anyway/Still Breathing Anyways is a Broken Sorrow album centered on survival and the idea 'I shouldn't be here.' Established material includes Velvet Lies, Last Call Halo, Tension in the Sound, I Am (Silence in Your Veins), Inside You, You Stayed, If Love Had a Voice, Holiday in the Dark, Same Old Ending, Still Breathing Anyway, The Remedy, Why Did I Survive, I Shouldn't Be Here, A Scar Named Yesterday, Can't Get Them Back Like This, Gravity of You, Beneath the Graveyard, Last Light on the Coast, and Signal in the Storm.

title: Broken City audio-world rules
content: Broken City uses recurring BCN Nightwatch broadcasts, emergency dispatch, advisories, rain, sirens, radio static, dead streetlights, transit announcements, and official-sounding warnings to make the city feel like an operating system of dread. Audio interludes should feel canonical and interconnected rather than decorative.

title: Broken City City Limits canon
content: City Limits follows an escape attempt in which the population sign changes from ONE to EVERYBODY, revealing that Broken City spreads through those who leave. His Honor appears on television with the line-level implication that the escapee now understands the city's mechanism.

title: Broken City His Honor canon
content: His Honor centers on City Hall at midnight, an eyeless receptionist, and a man who never won a vote. His function is permission and justification rather than direct coercion: he tells people where to hold the harm rather than forcing it himself.

title: Broken City Public Execution canon
content: Public Execution critiques spectatorship and victim-blaming. Suffering becomes spectacle, evidence, entertainment and moral judgment; bystanders film, frame, replay and debate victims rather than helping. The song's thesis is that Broken City puts bodies under lights and waits for people to admit they like to watch.

title: Therapy & Downz creative constraint
content: Therapy & Downz is a distinct project identity. The Gold Album and The Platinum Album should remain billed to Therapy & Downz unless Cory explicitly changes that. Relationship-song work for this project has at times specified no piano, so track-specific production constraints should be preserved rather than generalized blindly.

title: Creative software philosophy
content: When Cory asks to build creative software, he generally wants comprehensive, integrated tools rather than narrow single-purpose utilities: archives, metadata, media handling, AI assistance, composition/songwriting, export, desktop integration and future extensibility should be considered together.

title: Spider OS design philosophy
content: Spider OS should be original even when it uses other Linux distributions as technical references. Reference systems may contribute architecture, rollback, audio or packaging ideas, but Spider OS should own its branding, AI layer, Anchors, permissions, interface, sounds and workflow design.
source: Spider OS distro and branding conversations
